issues.description: Identified 1,478 missing customer emails, 1,990 missing phone numbers, and 57,848 unrecorded dine-in table numbers.
issues.remediation: Impute fallback values ('GUEST', 'UNKNOWN_TABLE') and preserve nulls in non-mandatory contact fields.

issues.description: Detected 200 exact duplicate order headers injected for Spark deduplication validation.
issues.remediation: Apply PySpark dropDuplicates(subset=['order_id']) keeping the first valid occurrence.

issues.description: Found 1,500 duplicate order line records causing inflated item subtotal calculations.
issues.remediation: Apply dropDuplicates(subset=['order_item_id']) prior to financial aggregation.

issues.description: Identified 8 menu items with negative prices, zero prices, or negative margins where cost exceeds selling price.
issues.remediation: Quarantine negative prices and recalibrate selling price based on category target margin (cost / (1 - margin)).

issues.description: Found 50 order items with negative quantities (-1) representing erroneous returns or data entry bugs.
issues.remediation: Filter or convert to absolute values if confirmed return or route to returns quarantine table.

issues.description: Identified 25 orders with future dates (e.g. 2026-08-20) or impossible calendar dates (2025-02-31).
issues.remediation: Quarantine invalid dates and parse with Spark to_date(..., 'yyyy-MM-dd') rejecting non-conforming rows.

issues.description: Found 45 ratings outside the allowed 1 to 5 Likert rating scale (scores of 0 or 6).
issues.remediation: Clip ratings to boundaries [1, 5] or discard corrupted records during sentiment ETL.

issues.description: Identified 4,017 orders without customer ID (anonymous walk-in/guest transactions).
issues.remediation: Assign surrogate guest customer ID 'CUST-GUEST' to enable cohort tracking without dropping orders.

issues.description: Detected 35 order-line items with missing/null item IDs, preventing item-level margin analysis.
issues.remediation: Quarantine records with null item_id for pos log reconciliation.

issues.description: Found 30 orders referencing invalid restaurant IDs ('LOC-999') not present in the master restaurants table.
issues.remediation: Filter out non-matching foreign keys using Left Anti Join quarantine before location reporting.

issues.description: Found 25 wastage records with impossible quantities (e.g. 9,999 units or negative wastage).
issues.remediation: Cap wastage quantities using interquartile range (IQR) or quarantine records exceeding max daily production limit.

issues.description: Identified 40 orders where discount amount exceeded total order subtotal or was negative.
issues.remediation: Recalculate discount based on promotion cap: discount = least(discount_amount, subtotal_amount, max_discount).

issues.description: Identified 9,510 cancelled and refunded transactions mixed into raw sales data.
issues.remediation: Separate cancelled orders into operational cancellation audit tables and exclude from net revenue metrics.

issues.description: Found 12 menu items with negative prep time (-10 min) or unrealistically high shelf life (9,999 days).
issues.remediation: Impute median category prep time and clamp shelf life to standard culinary thresholds (1 to 90 days).

issues.description: Detected 30 wastage records referencing unmapped location ID 'LOC-404'.
issues.remediation: Route unmapped location logs to inventory staging buffer and send alerts for master location mapping.
